headword: {集団行動|しゅうだんこうどう}

definitions.gloss: group action; collective behavior; acting as a group
definitions.explanation: Behavior or actions performed together as a group rather than individually. An important concept in Japanese schools and workplaces, where coordinated group activity is emphasized.

examples.japanese: {集団行動|しゅうだんこうどう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{苦手|にがて}→苦手：03513_nigate⟧だ。
examples.english: I'm not good at group activities.

examples.japanese: ⟦{学校|がっこう}→学校：00055_gakkou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{集団行動|しゅうだんこうどう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{大切|たいせつ}→大切：01456_taisetsu⟧さ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{学|まな}ぶ→学ぶ：01987_manabu⟧。
examples.english: At school, you learn the importance of group behavior.

examples.japanese: {災害時|さいがいじ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{落|お}ち{着|つ}いて→落ち着く：04670_ochitsuku⟧{集団行動|しゅうだんこうどう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}る→取る：00565_toru⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{求|もと}められる→求める：02316_motomeru⟧。
examples.english: During a disaster, people are expected to remain calm and act as a group.

notes: Compound of ⟦{集団|しゅうだん}→集団：03211_shuudan⟧ (group/collective) + ⟦{行動|こうどう}→行動：02728_koudou⟧ (action/behavior). Common collocations: {集団行動|しゅうだんこうどう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}る→取る：00565_toru⟧ (to act collectively), {集団行動|しゅうだんこうどう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{苦手|にがて}→苦手：03513_nigate⟧ (to be bad at group activities). In Japanese education, {集団行動|しゅうだんこうどう} is actively taught and practiced, including synchronized marching and group exercises during sports festivals. Contrasts with {個人行動|こじんこうどう} (individual action) and {単独行動|たんどくこうどう} (acting alone).
